summary_en: The company will cancel 1,000,000 common shares, representing 6.2% of issued shares before cancellation, effective November 27, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Toyo Kanetsu K.K. resolved at its November 13, 2026 board meeting to cancel 1,000,000 common shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act of Japan. The cancellation will become effective on November 27, 2026.

Based on the state of affairs as of September 30, 2026, the cancellation represents 6.2% of issued shares before cancellation. Following the cancellation, the number of issued shares will decrease to 15,046,148, with treasury stock remaining at 39,276 shares. The calculation excludes 235,400 treasury shares held by an employee stock ownership plan trust.
